answer: Bindings are kept in hollow, verified in wander, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the glacier check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
